data.say:
Note for the editor: the Japanese twice prints Tsunao as 鋼雄 (p77–p78) for 綱雄; the English normalises to Tsunao, as the bible directs — please check against the 1895 text.

Verdict: Ready. The English holds the reading to the end — Tatsuya charming in company and coarse in soliloquy, Mitsuyo's repetitions unvaried, the ending left unresolved — and the few sense errors found (the bath joke, the deer-whistles, the grain-ear misreading, and the unnamed subject opening p97) have been corrected.

House log: Final read completed; four sense fixes made and the text is ready to publish.
